# Cyrus One by Trivelles

> Premium hotel apartments near Islamabad International Airport — spacious serviced suites just 5km from the terminal and minutes from the M2 Motorway.

Cyrus One is a UK-standard hotel apartment brand located on Main Boulevard, near Mumtaz City, Airport Enclave Block A, Islamabad, Pakistan (44000). The property offers 55 rooms across 7 room types, from Standard Doubles to multi-bedroom Presidential Suites, each with a private kitchenette, balcony, and city views. Free airport pickup, complimentary breakfast, and free WiFi are included.

## Key Facts
- Location: 5km from Islamabad International Airport, near the M1/M2 Motorway interchange and Srinagar Highway
- Check-in: 2:00 PM, Check-out: 12:00 PM
- Phone: +92 322 4770222
- Room types: Standard Double, Deluxe Double, Deluxe Twin, Executive Suite, 3 Bed Executive, 2 Bed Suite, 2 Bed Presidential Suite
- Rating: 4.7/5 across Google, Booking.com, Agoda, Trip.com, and Expedia (244 combined reviews)
